description: Work main window only, bundled local origin only (no remote block, so no remote URL reaches any command). The core's default window permissions and this profile's app commands, allowed by name (they are declared in build.rs; core:default does not cover app commands). Capabilities are per profile and never copied between profiles: Work holds no device permission at all (the device grants are Field only, plan B.3), and nothing here is taken from hh-field's file.
